lead: Test build 0.8.22 (branch round-0.8.22, CI run 39042191698, version 0.8.22): patch and bank menus with submenus in our own popup on every system, the original's column rule for value lists, and the complete REMOTE page (template and knob names, MIDI string with info, the knob template list from your Access files, LOAD/SAVE of template files, sent to the Virus like the original - tested on Linux on 2026-10-17). Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches (LOAD in the patch menus is fine, SAVE there is not).
On the REMOTE page SAVE is fine: it writes template files only (a new file "MY TEST.vrt" in Documents/Access Music/Virus TI/Remote Templates; delete it afterwards if you like).
Order: macOS first (move the Virus to the Mac), then Linux, then the Windows 11 VM. Close the DAW before moving the Virus.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushes the package to the Mac when it is awake: ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22-mac. Quit Ableton, then in Terminal: sudo installer -pkg ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22-mac/"TI Revive.pkg" -target /
notes: New: the patch LOAD/SAVE menus and the browser bank menu are our own popup with submenus (before: the macOS menus).

items.title: Patch and bank menus with submenus
steps: Part 1: click LOAD. Move over the device entry, then over RAM A: the 128 patches. Move back and over Personal Libraries.
With the keyboard: Down, Right (opens the submenu), Left (closes it), Esc.
Pick a patch from ROM A with a click. BROWSER page: click the arrow of the upper bank bar, pick another bank.
items.expect: submenus open next to their entry (on the left when there is no room), the 128 patches in several columns; keys work; the patch loads into part 1; the browser shows the chosen bank.

items.title: Wavetable list opens without delay
steps: OSC page, oscillator 1 in Wavetable mode: right-click the table name a few times, move the mouse over the columns.
items.expect: the list appears at once and the highlight follows the mouse without lag (last round: a short delay).

items.title: REMOTE page
steps: PATCH UTILITY > REMOTE. Single-click template 3 (it is only highlighted), then double-click it.
Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.
Close and reopen the plug-in window (or the DAW project).
items.expect: the list shows MY TEST at 3; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

items.title: REMOTE LOAD and SAVE
steps: Double-click template 5. LOAD: look through the places; pick a factory template (e.g. under Remote Templates > Ableton) if one is listed.
SAVE > Personal Remote Templates > Save as new Template..
Double-click template 6, LOAD > Personal Remote Templates > the file you just saved.
items.expect: LOAD lists the places that have templates (note which ones and whether the factory templates appear); the loaded template's name shows at 5; a new file named after template 5 appears; template 6 gets the same name.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacks the test build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22-linux. In a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22-linux/TI-Revive-*-linux && sudo ./install.sh

items.title: Patch and bank menus with submenus
steps: Part 1: LOAD, over the device entry, over RAM A; back, over Personal Libraries; Esc.
Pick a patch from ROM A. BROWSER: the upper bank bar's arrow, pick another bank.
items.expect: as on macOS: submenus next to their entry, the 128 patches in columns, the patch loads, the browser shows the bank.

items.title: REMOTE page
steps: PATCH UTILITY > REMOTE. Single-click template 3 (it is only highlighted), then double-click it.
Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.
Close and reopen the plug-in window (or the DAW project).
items.expect: the list shows MY TEST at 3; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

items.title: REMOTE LOAD of a factory template
steps: Double-click template 7. LOAD > Personal Libraries > Remote Templates > Ableton > the template there.
items.expect: template 7 gets that template's name and knob names; the Virus keeps playing.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM

prep: Installed silently by Claude (0.8.22, one entry in Apps). Claude attaches the Virus when you get there (VM=win11 scripts/vm.sh attach).

BROWSER: the upper bank bar's arrow, pick another bank.
items.expect: submenus next to their entry, the 128 patches in columns, the patch loads, the browser shows the bank.

Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.

items.expect: the list shows MY TEST at 3; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

steps: Double-click template 7. LOAD > Personal Libraries > Remote Templates > Ableton > the template there (only if the Access software's templates are installed in the VM).
